snippet.title: What Da Font: Tidy Up the Print Shop | Demo announcement trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5283780/What_Da_Font_Tidy_Up_the_Print_Shop/

What Da Font: Tidy Up the Print Shop is a cozy first person organizing game set in a 1920s print shop. The free demo arrives on Steam on October 20. Wishlist now so you don't miss it.

Thieves turned over every type case in the print shop overnight. The master is away, and you are the apprentice left alone with five thousand pieces of lead type scattered across two floors. Find them, learn to tell ten historical typefaces apart by eye, and put every sort back where it lives.
Every case you finish opens a print job: set the text letter by letter, ink the forme and pull the poster on the press. Each sheet hides a number, and the ten posters on your wall spell out the combination to the master's safe.

🖨️ In the free demo (October 20)
Explore the ground floor, sort your first typefaces and print your first two posters. No timers, no fail state.

✨ Features
• Around 5,000 pieces of lead type to find and sort
• Ten historical typefaces, from elegant serifs to bold slabs
• Real letterpress printing: compose, ink and pull every poster by hand
• A safe whose combination you build yourself
• Abilities and hidden tools, grappling hook included
• Warm dawn light, painted interiors and a whole world outside the door
If you love cozy games, organizing games, typography or the craft of letterpress printing, this one is for you. Every wishlist really helps a small indie game like ours. Thank you! 💛

👉 Steam (wishlist and demo): https://store.steampowered.com/app/5283780/What_Da_Font_Tidy_Up_the_Print_Shop/
#WhatDaFont #CozyGames #IndieGame
